caption:
Anxious no matter how much you've saved? Your hope's on the wrong thing. (1 Timothy 6:17–19 devotional)

Hope pinned on uncertain riches stays anxious at any income. Paul tells the rich to shift their hope onto God — then giving stops feeling like losing and becomes storing up. What's moved to God becomes a foundation that won't collapse.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — where is your hope quietly resting — riches, or God?
